title: Pleasing coherence leaves parts unexplained

captions.physics: Returning to a convenient whole version

meaning: Seeking a whole picture can support examining a convenient coherent version while preserving room for relationships that remain unclear within it.
text: A convenient whole version can sound convincing while some relationships remain unclear. The Devil in the physical position of Ajna returns to an appealing explanation. The World in energy connects different parts of understanding. The Moon in emotions experiences uncertainty about particular relationships. You can enjoy an image of complete coherence and struggle to see how one actual detail, remembered differently by each person, belongs within it.

Suppose you again explain an exhibition through one overall idea because it beautifully connects most works. **A whole picture can include a question beyond a pleasing version.** You notice a work whose relationship to the image remains unclear. Seeking the whole helps examine its place while preserving the material’s particular qualities. Your view gains an open area without immediately inventing a suitable connection. Understood relationships retain value beside an unexplained one. A version’s appeal stays part of an impression while each person can offer an observation complicating a familiar account without losing interest in the exhibition.

The risk is calling an awkward detail accidental to preserve complete coherence. Attention to the whole reveals its need for a particular question. Your view develops when uncertainty has a concrete place. A favourite version can then have its limits examined, while an unclear feeling need neither destroy every explanation nor disappear for the sake of beautiful completion for both people.
